canonical_statement: For Borel probability measures mu_n and mu on finite-dimensional real coordinate space, mu_n converges weakly to mu if and only if, for every real coefficient vector t, the pushforwards of mu_n under x |-> sum_i t_i x_i converge weakly to the corresponding pushforward of mu.
domain_and_universes: d n : Nat; points and coefficients provisionally Fin d -> Real; Borel probability measures on that space; Prop in Lean universe 0
quantifiers: mu : probability measure on Fin d -> Real
mu_n : Nat -> probability measure on Fin d -> Real
t : Fin d -> Real (universal in the projection condition)
hypotheses: each mu_n is a Borel probability measure
mu is a Borel probability measure
conclusion: weak convergence mu_n -> mu is equivalent to weak convergence of every scalar linear pushforward
